title: External warehouse projection
description: Warehouse registry whitelist without MISA, source, evidence, or audit fields.

warehouse_type.description: Warehouse type, closed set (the ops-core database check constraint): RAW_MATERIAL (raw material warehouse) or FINISHED_GOODS (finished goods warehouse). Upper case, compared byte for byte. Same vocabulary as schemas/ops/warehouse.schema.json. FINISHED_GOODS is plural and is not the same string as the item_type FINISHED_GOOD (singular) of the stock balance, the ledger and the allocations: item_type names an inventory ITEM, warehouse_type a kind of WAREHOUSE. Both strings stay as they are; compare them byte for byte and never normalise one into the other (docs/m3-allocation-integration-notes.md section 9).

status.description: Warehouse lifecycle status, closed set. INACTIVE is a lifecycle state, not a deletion: the warehouse stays in the snapshot.
